name: Roxo-paper BB-MCTS (purchase, combat move, non-combat move)
description: Bridge Burning MCTS as Roxo's thesis applies it to TripleA, on the oep_paper framework: one tree ply per territory (or unit rule) decision with Roxo's pruned options, UCT X + C sqrt(ln n / n_j) with C = 1/sqrt 2, 10-round playouts whose phases are random with probability 0.5 and otherwise Roxo's Weak AI, Roxo's reward, deterministic Fast AI battles, burn phases keeping the most promising root child.
